test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in indirect speech.

Rahul says, “I go to the gym daily.”

options.text: Rahul said that he goes to the gym every day.
Rahul explained that I go to the gym daily.
Rahul says that he goes to the gym daily.
Rahul told that he went to the gym daily.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Rahul says that he goes to the gym daily.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The given question is an assertive sentence and in the simple present tense.
 
• The process of conversion is as follows:
 
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed.
 
• Reporting speech is in the simple present tense. Hence tense will not be changed.
 
• 'I' will be changed into 'he' because the first-person pronouns are changed according to the subject of the reporting verb.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"*****Rahul says that he goes to the gym daily."***
